author: Doc Holliday
title: These Are Missouri's 10 Best Coffee Shops, Reviews Say - NewsBreak
text:
By Doc Holliday ,
2 hours ago
Some people chase great coffee the way Indiana Jones seeks after historic treasure. If that’s your worldview, you should know there are many coffee shops in Missouri that are rated higher than others according to online reviews.
Instead of relying on one bloggers opinions, I queried the internet databases to seek out the best coffee shops in Missouri sorted by their online reviews. I was looking for a ranking that balances star ratings, review counts, local popularity, and specialty-coffee reputation. Here are the 10 highest-rated coffee shops based on those factors.
Click here to view photo gallery What I found interesting is that Missouri has a wide variety of coffee places including at least one in the top 10 that specializes in Vietnamese coffee. I mean nothing against the big coffee chains, but I was happy to see so many mom and pop and family-owned coffee places make up the top 10 list.
Is coffee good for you or not? According to the National Institute of Health , coffee consumed in a “moderate intake (about 2–4 cups daily) (can lead) to a lower risk of type 2 diabetes, heart failure, and certain neurological diseases” due to the antioxidants coffee contains. I have friends and family members who refuse to start their day without some form of java. The only question is what type of creamer to add. Decisions, decisions.
